name: Chicken Tenders with Za'atar Yogurt & Minty Arugula-Pistachio Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F). Coat two baking sheet pans with a thin layer of oil.
Place mayo and spices in a large bowl, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels, then slice crosswise into ¾-inch strips. Add to the bowl with the mayo mixture and toss to coat.
Add bread crumbs to the bowl with the chicken and turn to coat, pressing gently to adhere. Divide chicken between the baking sheets and arrange in a single layer.
Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, mayo, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the za'atar yogurt and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp thyme, dried
1 ½ tsp sesame seeds
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Place oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp honey
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then slice crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pistachios. Add to the bowl.
When the chicken is almost done, add arugula to the bowl, and toss to combine the salad.
Divide chicken tenders and salad between plates. Serve with za'atar yogurt for dipping and enjoy!
